name: @rindle/example-issue-tracker
description: Real-world demo of the daemon/serverless topology: an issue tracker — always-up Rindle daemon + serverless-shaped API server + optimistic React client.

scripts.build:runtime: cargo build --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml --bins -p rindle-cli -p rindle-server -p rindle-replicator -p rindle-dev-edge && pnpm --filter @rindle/wasm run build:wasm
scripts.dev: pnpm build:runtime && RINDLE_DAEMON_TOKEN=dev-daemon-token concurrently -k -n daemon,web -c blue,green "pnpm dev:daemon" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: pnpm rindle exec -- node --conditions=@rindle/source server/seed.ts && pnpm rindle exec -- vite dev
scripts.dev:swarm: pnpm build:runtime && RINDLE_DAEMON_TOKEN=dev-daemon-token concurrently -k -n daemon,web,swarm -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:daemon" "pnpm dev:web:swarm" "pnpm rindle exec -- pnpm swarm"
scripts.dev:web:swarm: pnpm rindle exec -- node --conditions=@rindle/source server/seed.ts && VITE_METRICS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7711/metrics pnpm rindle exec -- vite dev
scripts.migrate: cargo build --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml -p rindle-cli && pnpm rindle migrate apply --dir migrations
scripts.migrate:local: cargo build --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml -p rindle-cli && pnpm rindle exec -- pnpm rindle migrate apply --dir migrations
scripts.preview:cf: CF=1 vite build && wrangler dev -c dist/server/wrangler.json
